bids.description:
Let’s build this together—I'll act as your Canton Fair industrial-electronics sourcing partner in Guangzhou, focused on show-floor technical validation, not generic buying. I’ll walk the Industrial Electronics halls with you, interpret Mandarin specs/capability claims, and rapidly shortlist booths whose datasheets, certifications, and process details fit your BOM targets. Expect real engineer-level checks: SMT line capability, IPC workmanship standards, BOM optimization vs MOQ/cost, reliability test expectations, component selection logic, enclosure tolerances, and compliance marks. Native-level Mandarin plus solid English ensures zero loss in translation with factory engineers.

During each fair day I’ll capture high-resolution, annotated photos; record contacts, lead times, and technical notes; and when samples are offered, I’ll perform an on-the-spot quality inspection of PCB workmanship and critical assemblies.

Hi there,
I’m Nethys Liao, a local sourcing specialist based in the Guangzhou with 10+ years of industrial procurement, supplier qualification and on-site quality inspection experience. I’m very interested in supporting you during the upcoming Canton Fair.
My background aligns closely with your requirements:
Language & local availability: Native Mandarin and Cantonese speaker, with full working English proficiency. I am based locally and can be fully present in Guangzhou every day of the fair, and available for follow-up factory visits in the surrounding electronics hubs.
On-site technical & quality assessment: I have hands-on experience sourcing and auditing industrial components including PCB assemblies. I can conduct spot quality checks on PCB workmanship, component selection, enclosure tolerances and compliance marks, and hold technical discussions directly with factory engineers on SMT capabilities, IPC standards, BOM optimisation and MOQ implications.
Structured deliverables: I will organise all findings into the exact outputs you need — a vetted supplier matrix with key specs and initial pricing, high-resolution sample photos annotated with quality observations, and a prioritised recommendation list with clear next-step actions.
One practical note: I have not yet obtained a Canton Fair entry badge. As an overseas buyer, would you pls be able to assist with applying for an escort badge for me?
Looking forward to your reply.

Hello, I am a sourcing agent who can help you find Chinese manufacturers, compare prices, and take you directly to factories to meet suppliers and discuss your requirements.

Please share your product details and travel dates so we can arrange suitable factory visits and confirm the service fee.

source.description:
I will be in Guangzhou for the Autumn Canton Fair, and I want a local sourcing partner who truly speaks the language of industrial-grade electronics manufacturing. Your role starts on the show floor: walk the Industrial Electronics halls with me, quickly spot booths whose datasheets, process capabilities and certifications match my specs, and capture clear photos, contacts and technical notes. When a sample is offered, I will depend on you to give an on-the-spot quality check, PCB workmanship, component selection, enclosure tolerances, compliance marks.

I expect an advanced understanding of electronics: you should be comfortable discussing SMT line capabilities, IPC standards, reliability testing, BOM optimisation and MOQ implications with factory engineers, not just sales staff. Native-level Mandarin (Cantonese is a bonus) plus competent English is essential so nothing is lost in translation.

Because my schedule is tight, I need you in Guangzhou each day of the fair and available for short factory follow-ups in the surrounding area if a lead proves promising. By the end of the event, I will need the following:

• A concise supplier matrix listing at least 10 vetted industrial-electronics manufacturers, with key specs, capabilities and initial price indicators  
• High-resolution photos of inspected samples annotated with your quality observations  
• Your prioritised recommendation list with next-step actions

If you already have established contacts in power electronics, control boards, sensors or ruggedised assemblies, let me know in your reply, those niches align closely with my roadmap.
